slide_catalog.title: Vision — We Heard YouPwC's Proposal Is Built on Your Own Blueprint
text_blocks: Vision — We Heard YouPwC's Proposal Is Built on Your Own Blueprint
Proposal for Global Payments Prague Shared Service Center Transformation

This proposal directly responds to the SSC Concept by Global Payments. The client's vision, defines the SSC as a "centralized organizational unit/own entity providing services across multiple entities" that "operates as an internal service provider with defined services and performance levels" and "evolves into a centre of excellence over time."

PwC's Role: We are here to operationalize this vision — to take the "what" and "why" and deliver the "how" through structured workstreams, proven methodologies, industry benchmarks, and hands-on implementation support.

Bringing clarity, accountability, and scale into one entity, we turn complexity into a competitive advantage for the whole group.Global Payments SSC Vision
PwC is ready to make this vision operational.

Dual-Axis RACI — For each process/service, the RACI explicitly shows both the functional accountability (Prague SSC) and business line accountability (country/product group)
Conflict Resolution Protocol — Where RACI reveals two groups claiming "A", PwC facilitates resolution workshops with a structured decision framework
Business Partner as Alignment Broker (WS2) — BPs serve as the ongoing mechanism to keep direct and dotted-line stakeholders aligned
